name: OPS-SAT strict two-stage acceptance and conventional conservative baseline
status: pre-registered exploratory; original OPS-SAT held-out 529 EXCLUDED and internal audit160 historically seen
source: OPS-SAT genuine 2578D engineered descriptors + 18 official features

msf.prior_best_dimension_not_fixed: subset size may change with old subset, do not claim universal optimum

model: same original StandardScaler + weighted binary LogisticRegression as earlier pilot
threshold: use first internal validation half only, select max F1; never use acceptance/ audit

policies.B: conventional retrain old+simulated batch with own calibration-only alarm threshold
policies.C: ordinary binary F1 AP recall FPR noninferiority on second disjoint acceptance half
policies.D: C plus calibration-quality noninferiority Brier and NLL on second acceptance half
policies.E: predeclared convex old/new probability mixture alpha in 0,.25,.5,.75,1 selected on calibration-only Brier; then independent acceptance C and D constraints

known_limits: Prior audits have been seen on same dataset; this is a retrospective exploratory protocol not a fresh prospective confirmatory test
Selected 64 budget from prior exploratory results; cannot call global optimum
Current original OPS-SAT only binary abnormal/normal; no real physical HMM or H/D/F labels
Scenario errors are artificially injected; neither real human approval nor new operational regime
Safe guard rejection is not a successful adaptation if all valid updates rejected
Channel/time-correlated telemetry segments can reduce effective sample independence
No privately sensitive invention algorithm publicly disclosed
Original official train flag zero never accessed for model fitting, calibration, acceptance, audit
